comparison.objective: Adjust and lock a robot-gripper stop versus transport four visually identical cups with hidden, different payloads.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires countertorque between a hex driver and wrench; cup handling requires payload-sensitive grip-force adaptation that avoids slip and panel buckling.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked angle retention; cup scoring awards each upright released placement only after a valid side-wall lift without crushing, dropping, or excessive tilt.
comparison.reason: Force control is shared only at a broad level; adaptive grasp-force inference is different from preserving a threaded setting.
